# Front of the POWDER polygon queue (app_multi.py mode=powder).
# Ordered by SCENE, not by any model: table / gantry views first, then
# unclustered frames, then the blender-station close-ups (powder never
# appears there) at the tail.
#
# Model ranking was tried and discarded: powder-holdout-v1 reached mask
# mAP50 0.0012 on a strict scene holdout and its confidences were pinned
# flat at the 0.012 floor, so every ordering it produced was an arbitrary
# tie-break. Scene grouping is from k-means on 32x18 grayscale thumbnails.
# Re-rank by model once ~20 more frames carry powder outlines.
